HYDRAA & FTL Verification in Hyderabad

Construction inside a lake's Full Tank Level or buffer zone can be demolished by HYDRAA. We check FTL maps and buffer boundaries before you buy or build.

Key Takeaways

  • HYDRAA protects Hyderabad's lakes and government assets and can demolish construction inside FTL and buffer zones.
  • Full Tank Level (FTL) is the maximum water-spread boundary of a lake; buffer zones extend beyond it.
  • Plots inside FTL or the buffer are effectively un-buildable and highly risky to buy.
  • We check the property against FTL maps, buffer-zone boundaries and HYDRAA notifications.
  • Vital for plots and villas near lakes, nalas and low-lying areas across Greater Hyderabad.

Some of the most attractively located plots in Hyderabad sit dangerously close to lakes and nalas. If a plot falls within a lake's Full Tank Level or its protected buffer zone, any construction on it is liable to be removed by HYDRAA.

JaaGa verifies whether a property lies inside an FTL or buffer zone using the available lake and boundary maps, so you don't buy land you can never safely build on.

When You Need an FTL / HYDRAA Check

Before buying any plot, villa or open land near a lake, tank, nala or low-lying catchment area.

Before starting construction, and before booking in a new layout or gated project marketed as 'lake view'.

How We Verify

  1. 1

    Locate the Plot

    We pin the property to its survey number and geographic location.

  2. 2

    Overlay FTL & Buffer

    We check the location against available FTL maps and buffer-zone boundaries for nearby water bodies.

  3. 3

    Check Notifications

    We review HYDRAA and lake-protection notifications relevant to the area.

  4. 4

    Risk Report

    You receive a clear inside/outside FTL & buffer assessment with the associated construction risk.

Documents Required

  • Survey/plot number and sub-division
  • Village / locality and nearest lake or nala
  • Layout or plot location map (if available)
  • Current owner details

Common Problems We Solve

Layouts marketed near lakes

Attractive lakeside layouts may sit partly in the buffer. We check the specific plot, not the brochure.

Shifting FTL boundaries

FTL demarcation can be revised. We use the current available maps and notifications.

Nala and low-lying risk

It isn't only lakes — nalas and catchments matter too. We flag these.

Why HYDRAA & FTL Verification Matters

HYDRAA demolitions have shown how quickly construction inside a lake boundary can be lost, with no compensation. Verifying FTL and buffer status before you buy is the difference between a safe investment and a plot you can never legally build on.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is HYDRAA?

The Hyderabad Disaster Response and Assets Protection Agency, tasked with protecting the city's lakes, buffer zones and government assets — including removing encroachments.

What is FTL?

Full Tank Level — the maximum water-spread boundary of a lake or tank. Construction inside the FTL, and often the buffer beyond it, is prohibited.

Can I build on a plot in the buffer zone?

Construction in FTL and buffer zones is restricted and liable to demolition. Such plots are best avoided.

How do you check FTL status?

We locate the plot and check it against available FTL and buffer-zone maps and HYDRAA notifications for the area.

Is this needed for gated communities?

Yes — even approved-looking projects can have blocks near a buffer. We verify the specific plot or unit location.
